title: Make the Ghost Ship artwork reliably visible on Forge

phases.title: Provision the bundled Ghost Ship map into world storage and provide a redundant floor tile
Repair already-created Ghost Ship scenes without touching walls, doors, lights, or tokens
Publish the map delivery repair as module 0.3.2

finalChecks.name: World-storage map provisioning exists
finalChecks.run: grep -q 'provisionGhostShipMapAsset' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs && grep -q 'FilePicker.upload' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs && grep -q 'raw.githubusercontent.com/jonkellyrice-cmyk/Foundry-scenes/main/assets/maps/signatory-ghost-ship.webp' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs

finalChecks.name: Manifest version
finalChecks.run: node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('module.json','utf8')); if(m.version!=='0.3.2') throw new Error('expected module 0.3.2');"
